purpose: Implement the shared release-artifact provenance and authenticated-manifest trust boundary so APP-01 can later install, update or roll back only bytes that match an exact target-bound manifest with traceable source/build/dependency/license inputs and independently verified authenticity.

lineage.outcome: Package/update bytes cannot become an install candidate merely because a file exists: N0TE can verify exact source/build/dependency/license provenance, exact platform target, exact bytes and an independently authenticated manifest revision before execution is even considered.
lineage.capability: Release manifest provenance and fail-closed artifact verification

legacy_rejections: shared-secret test masquerading as production code signing

completion_proof: ReleaseManifest requires exact release/version identity, 40-hex source commit SHA and SHA-256 build-input, dependency-inventory and license-inventory digests
ArtifactRecord requires unique artifact ID, exact PLATFORM-00C target fingerprint, normalized package kind, positive byte size and SHA-256
manifest artifact ordering is canonical and manifest fingerprint deterministic
duplicate artifact IDs and duplicate target/package routes are rejected
ManifestAuthenticityEvidence binds status, verifier identity, verification scheme and evidence ref to the exact manifest fingerprint
missing, UNKNOWN or UNTRUSTED authenticity fails closed
VERIFIED authenticity for another manifest fingerprint returns MANIFEST_MISMATCH
unknown artifact, wrong expected target, size mismatch and SHA-256 mismatch remain distinct failures
exact artifact bytes plus exact target plus VERIFIED exact-manifest authenticity return READY
multiple artifacts in one manifest verify independently
changing source/build/dependency/license provenance changes the manifest fingerprint
older release manifests may still verify READY so rollback selection remains APP-01 policy rather than artifact-trust magic
ReleaseArtifactVerifier is pure and exposes no install/update/rollback/sign/download/execute behavior

Keep plugin hosting/discovery under AUDIO-02 and real macOS/Windows/Linux package/acceptance under APP-01 + PLATFORM-01/02/03.
